assembly.name: Engine — intake & boost (IS38, manifold w/ flaps)
assembly.description: The air/boost path (dossier §2): airbox → IHI IS38 turbo with motorised wastegate → front-mount intercooler → throttle body → the plastic variable-runner intake manifold (06L133201FP) with its V157 flap motor and G336 position sensor — the assembly behind the P2015 fault this project set out to explain. Select the manifold, flaps, V157 or G336 and use the flap/fault controls in the panel.

parts.name: Air filter box & intake tract
parts.description: Airbox with panel element, 5Q0129607AC (supersedes 5Q0129607AG) (R3). Fresh air enters via the front duct/snorkel (5Q0129617/18-series), through the filter and the turbo-inlet pipe to the IS38 compressor.
knownIssues: Cracks or a loose lid admit unmetered air (R3).

parts.name: Turbocharger, IHI IS38
parts.description: IHI IS38 (RHF5) turbo on the head's integrated exhaust manifold — Golf R most commonly shipped 06K145702J / 06K145874F; the family spans 06K145702H/J/M/N, 06K145722A/H/T, 06K145874F/N and is shared with Audi S3 8V / TTS Mk3 (R3). Compressor wheel 45.2/58.0 mm, turbine 47.4/54.7 mm, plain journal bearing. Turbo-to-head M8 nuts 25 Nm (vendor-verified; renew self-locking nuts). Turbine outlet joins the downpipe with a V-band clamp — not nuts.

torqueSpec.note: Turbo-to-head M8 nuts (R3, vendor DIY-verified — treat as strong indicative); renew self-locking nuts

knownIssues: Wastegate/actuator-rod play → cold rattle on accel/decel; VAG issued anti-rattle clip service actions, and P0299 from link-plate play can mean turbo replacement (R3, TSB SB-10052519).
Journal-bearing/compressor-wheel failure on tuned or oil-starved cars (R3).

parts.name: Charge pressure actuator V465 (electric wastegate)
parts.description: The DC-motor electric wastegate actuator — there is NO vacuum N75 on this engine (R3). After any turbo/actuator work the rod must be mechanically pre-set (door to contact, then 1.5 turns per APR, jam nut tight, ≈3.6 V on the acknowledgment channel) and then stop-learned in VCDS: Basic Settings → 'First Adaptation of charge pressure actuator' (IDE04304) — otherwise P2563/EPC. SSP says replace the actuator if the rod nuts are loosened. HANON cross-refs 06K145614G/06L145614B/D. Note the UK '722S' turbo revision reportedly carries an IS20-style actuator — verify by connector orientation.
knownIssues: Rattle, seized rod, or lost stop-adaptation → P2563 (Turbo Boost Control Position Sensor Implausible) / EPC (R3).

parts.name: Turbo air recirculation valve N249 (diverter)
parts.description: Electric recirculation/diverter valve on the compressor housing venting boost on lift-off (R3). 06H145710-series with a GENUINE revision disagreement: the famous 'Rev D' piston upgrade is for Gen 1/2 and reportedly does NOT fit Gen 3 — Gen 3 cars shipped 06H145710C (later J). Verify before ordering. 3× M6 screws (4 mm hex) at 9 Nm.
knownIssues: Torn diaphragm (early revisions), cracked plastic or electrical fault → P0299/P0033 (R3).

parts.name: Charge pipe, hot side (turbo → intercooler)
parts.description: Plastic turbo-outlet pipe, 5Q0145770-series (e.g. 5Q0145770A) (R3 — verify suffix). The turbo-muffler/'pancake' coupler on this run is a classic MQB boost-leak point under raised boost.
knownIssues: Coupler blow-off under boost — the reason aftermarket aluminium pipe kits exist (R3).

parts.name: Intercooler, front-mount air-to-air
parts.description: Front-mount air-to-air intercooler, 5Q0145803-series (supersessions S/P/L → AA → AE; shared R/S3/GTI) (R3 — verify suffix). Mounted low in the front stack.
knownIssues: Condensation pooling → cold/humid-morning misfires; end-tank cracks (R3).

parts.name: Charge pipe, cold side (intercooler → throttle)
parts.description: Cold-side charge pipe from intercooler up to the throttle, 5Q0145762-series (R3 — verify suffix; APR's MS100194 replaces it). Carries the G31 charge-pressure sender. Clamp torques not found — per WSM.
knownIssues: Coupler failure and cracking under boost (R3).

parts.name: Throttle body J338 / GX3
parts.description: Drive-by-wire throttle module (J338, with integral G187/G188 position senders), 06L133063-series — exact CJXC number needs a VIN check (R3). Gasket 06K133073 — the number the original brief mistook for the manifold. Re-run VCDS throttle adaptation after cleaning or removal.

torqueSpec.note: Indicative M6-class only — R3 could not extract the manual's value (per WSM before real work)

knownIssues: Carbon on the plate → sticky/hunting idle; actuator wear (R3).

parts.name: Intake manifold with runner flaps (06L133201FP)
parts.description: Glass-filled polyamide manifold, two shells plastic-welded, with integral tumble flaps, N316 actuator and G336 sensor — 06L133201FP is the best-documented CJXC fit (R3 confirms the recorded number; supersedes T/CM/EM/FA, and the later 06L133201FR ships complete with gasket, solenoid and sensor). Flap internals are not separately serviceable, so a seized flap means a manifold. Manifold-to-head bolt torque NOT found — per WSM (generic M6 = 10 Nm class).
knownIssues: P2015 sets two ways (R3): (a) carbon binding the flap shaft — the mechanical failure; (b) lost end-stop adaptation after service (exactly this car's walnut-blast scenario) — fixed with NO parts via VCDS Basic Settings Group 142 / G336 guided adaptation.

parts.name: Runner flaps & shaft (tumble flaps) ×4 on common shaft
parts.description: Tumble/charge-motion flaps on a common shaft inside each runner, with the external return spring, linkage and end stops the ECU's adaptation relearns (R3). Closed at idle/low load for tumble and stable idle; open above the load threshold for flow. Not sold separately.
knownIssues: A worn/detached flap arm is one of the two classic P2015 roots — fix is the complete manifold 06L133201FP (dossier §2)

parts.name: Intake flap actuator N316
parts.description: R3 DESIGNATION CORRECTION: on this MQB petrol engine SSP 606 calls the flap actuator N316 — 'V157' is the old PQ-platform TDI name. A DC motor and reduction gears driving the flap shaft, integral to the manifold; VW sells no standalone motor, so a stalled motor means a manifold. The ECU closed-loops its commanded position against G336's measured angle.
knownIssues: If Output Test [03] shows no flap movement, V157/linkage is implicated → complete manifold replacement

parts.name: Flap position sensor G336 (06K907386D)
parts.description: The flap-position potentiometer the P2015 plausibility check reads: ~4.5 V flaps closed falling to ~1.2 V open (forum-grade curve — the 0.76/0.38 V figures online are the TDI unit). The ONLY serviceable flap part: it pulls out of the manifold after bending aside retaining tabs (R3). PART NUMBER CONFLICT: the dossier recorded 06K907386D, but R3 found no standalone PN — VW sells the sensor with the manifold. Verify against ETKA before ordering. After any manifold/G336 work, re-run the Group 142 adaptation.
knownIssues: Implausible G336 signal with an intact linkage → replace the sensor alone (06K907386D), then re-run Group 142 basic settings (dossier §2)

parts.name: Manifold-to-head bolts (T30) ×5
parts.description: T30 bolts fixing the manifold flange to the head. Dossier §2: intake-manifold-to-head T30 bolts torque to ~9 Nm.

torqueSpec.note: Dossier value — R3 could not extract the manual's manifold-bolt table (RG24), so treat as indicative; per WSM before real work

parts.name: Charge-pressure sender G31
parts.description: Bosch charge-pressure sender in the pipe between intercooler and throttle (R3). One of TWO 'MAP' sensors on the car — the other is the manifold's combined GX9 module. The ECU closed-loops boost on this plus the manifold sender.

parts.name: Combined manifold sender GX9 (G71 + G42)
parts.description: The manifold-side TMAP module: G71 intake-manifold pressure + G42 intake-air temperature in one push-fit sensor (R3; 04E906051/06K-series — verify exact number).

parts.name: Turbo oil feed & return lines
parts.description: Oil feed (06K145735-series) and return (06K145757-series) lines — R3 CORRECTION: OEM MQB lines are O-ring/bracket fittings at 9 Nm (8 mm triple-square), NOT banjo bolts (banjos are aftermarket-kit hardware). Seals WHT-006-113 ×2 / gasket WHT-006-112.

torqueSpec.note: All turbo line fitting bolts (R3, vendor-verified)

knownIssues: Feed-line coking/blockage → turbo bearing failure — why oil choice and intervals matter on these cars (R3).

parts.name: Turbo coolant feed & return lines
parts.description: Coolant feed (06K121497-series) and return (06K121496-series) to the water-cooled turbo bearing housing; O-ring fittings, bolts 9 Nm (R3). Seals WHT-006-114 / WHT-006-124.
